sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The schemes are part of the Atma Nirbhar program announced during the Budget session held in February this year. A total amount of Rs 120 crores – Rs 60 crores for each scheme has been allocated to the two concerned departments of Agriculture and Horticulture.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Agriculture,Rural & Environment; Sector: Agricultural Inputs- seeds, fertilizer etc.

**Detailed Description:** Atma Nirbhar Bagwani Yojana is an umbrella scheme wherein all the schemes are subsumed under a bank-linked credit subsidy scheme, which will have a time-bound implementation and participation from various stakeholders – Government, Bank, Project Consultants, and Progressive Farmers. The beneficiaries under the scheme will be eligible for 45% subsidy from the Government of Arunachal Pradesh, 45% bank finance, and 10% beneficiary's contribution. The beneficiary will have to provide collateral security in the shape of land/property or an acceptable guarantee for a loan amount exceeding 1.6 Lakhs in case of individuals and 10 lakhs for SHGs/FPOs. Under this scheme, the following components are included for availing a bank loan: - Arecanut - Pineapple - Avocado - Dragon Fruit - Orange - Banana - Guava - Tractor - Power Tiller - Brush Cutter

**Benefits / Assistance:** - Atmanirbhar Bagwani Yojna is basically meant for the cultivation of fruits like apples, walnut, orange, kiwi, and persimmon. - The line of credit will be provided by the State Bank Of India, Arunachal Pradesh Rural Bank, and Arunachal Pradesh Cooperative Apex Bank. - 45 percent will be given by the government subsidy, 45 percent as bank loan and 10 percent will be contributed by the farmer. - There is no collateral for loans up to Rs 1.60 lakh. - For SHGs, no collateral is needed up to Rs 10 lakhs.

**Application Process:** The interested farmer/SHG/FPO is required to submit their duly filled application form and proposai along with a self-attested passport size photograph to the Horticulture Development Office in their respective Circle during the Office working hours to avail the scheme. > **Application Form:** > [https://cdn.s3waas.gov.in/s3819f46e52c25763a55cc642422644317/uploads/2022/05/2022052453.pdf](https://cdn.s3waas.gov.in/s3819f46e52c25763a55cc642422644317/uploads/2022/05/2022052453.pdf)
